exchanges: ugh monday again. coffee is not workin yet
Hope the second cup does the trick!
so i finally started at Halvorsen last week, the vet clinic on the hill
Congrats on the new job, that's exciting!
first few days were chaos tho lol
The first week anywhere is always a whirlwind.
my sister lives out in Kelloway now and its such a trek to visit her
That's a long haul, but worth it to see her.
anyway got roped into a work potluck friday
Potlucks are a good excuse to try a new recipe.
Tobias keeps trying to get me into fencing, he goes like three nights a week
Sounds like he's really hooked on it!
i take the ferry in every morning which is honestly the best part of my day
That sounds like a lovely way to start the day.
weather was gross today tho, total sideways rain
Ugh, sideways rain is the worst.
my nephew Rory is doing geology at uni, he sent me a pic of some rock lol
Ha, that's sweet of him to share his finds.
my landlord pulled up in this ancient Skoda to fix the sink
At least he showed up to fix it!
sink is still dripping btw
Oh no, hopefully he comes back soon.
my sister-in-law has a cute little flat in Penhallow
That sounds cozy!
been picking up my mandolin again after like a year off
Nice, it's great you're getting back into it.
fingers hurt tho haha
That'll ease up once the calluses come back.
doc says the wrist thing is tendonitis so no heavy lifting for a bit
Sorry to hear that, take it easy on it.
which is fun when your job involves lifting dogs
That does sound tricky with all those patients.
my friend Dara wants to do dinner at Olivetti saturday, its her fave
That sounds like a great plan for the weekend.
might be too tired though, we'll see
No pressure, you can decide closer to the day.
my cat Pemberton knocked a whole plant off the shelf last night
Cats really do love chaos.
dirt everywhere. EVERYWHERE
Oh no, that's a messy cleanup.
ok vacuumed. sitting down finally
You've earned the rest!
potluck plan is just gonna be store bought cookies honestly
No shame in that, everyone loves cookies.
now bingeing Columbo reruns, the raincoat guy is the best
Classic detective shows never get old.
ok bed soon. night
Sleep well!
